water-lower-yosemite-fall.summary: At the restroom near the west end of the Lower Yosemite Fall loop, across the road from the Lodge.

water-bridalveil.summary: At the Bridalveil Fall trailhead restroom off Wawona Road, where NPS lists a bottle-filling station.

water-vernal-footbridge.summary: By the restroom at the Vernal Fall footbridge, roughly 0.8 miles up from the trailhead. NPS calls it the only drinking water on the trail beyond Happy Isles.

water-happy-isles.summary: At shuttle stop 16 next to the Mist Trail and John Muir Trail trailhead. Fill up before the climb.

water-lodge-lobby.summary: Inside the Lodge lobby; the operator's 2023 property map marks a refill station in this building.

ice-lodge-hemlock.summary: At the Hemlock building, marked ICE on the operator's Lodge property map. The map or the front desk will point you to the machine.

ice-lodge-maple.summary: At the Maple building, marked ICE on the operator's Lodge property map. The map or the front desk will point you to the machine.

ice-lodge-cottonwood.summary: At the Cottonwood building, marked ICE on the operator's Lodge property map. The map or the front desk will point you to the machine.

ice-lodge-aspen.summary: At the Aspen building, marked ICE on the operator's Lodge property map. The map or the front desk will point you to the machine.

ice-lodge-cedar.summary: On the walkway between Cedar and the gift shop, as shown on the operator's Lodge property map. The front desk knows whether it runs in the off-season.

ice-housekeeping.summary: In the small ice-machine building that NPS maps in the southern part of Housekeeping Camp.

fac-water-mariposa-grove-trailhead-drink.summary: At the Mariposa Grove arrival area and trailhead. NPS lists drinking water here in summer only and none further into the grove.

fac-water-mariposa-grove-welcome-plaza-d.summary: At the Mariposa Grove Welcome Plaza parking and restroom area, where NPS lists a bottle-filling station.

water-osm-3060358933.summary: Near the Exploration Center restroom and theater; the community record describes a fountain you can fill a bottle from.

water-osm-3453503953.summary: Near the Valley Tours kiosk between the Village Store and the Welcome Center. The record notes a bottle tap with an old fault report, so have a backup.
water-osm-3453503953.notice: A repair report from April 13, 2015 said the bottle-filling tap was out of order. Nobody has confirmed a fix; do not count on this tap.

water-osm-3700489301.summary: At the restroom in the Village parking area on the way to the Welcome Center; a community-mapped covered fountain.

water-osm-4562814053.summary: On the west side of the Village Store area near the Welcome Center; a community-mapped fountain.

water-osm-6467054285.summary: Near the Church Bowl picnic-area restroom. NPS lists a bottle-filling station; the community point gives the approximate spot.

water-osm-4150372240.summary: A community-mapped water point near units 179 and 180. Check for the potable sign and whether the camp allows access.

water-osm-4150372241.summary: A community-mapped water point near units 176 and 177. Check for the potable sign and whether the camp allows access.

water-osm-4150372243.summary: A community-mapped water point near units 218 and 219. Check for the potable sign and whether the camp allows access.

water-osm-4150372244.summary: A community-mapped water point near units 190 and 191. Check for the potable sign and whether the camp allows access.

water-osm-4150372246.summary: A community-mapped water point near units 236 and 237. Check for the potable sign and whether the camp allows access.

water-osm-4150372248.summary: A community-mapped water point near units 222 and 223. Check for the potable sign and whether the camp allows access.

water-osm-5103495257.summary: Near the Curry Village Pavilion. The community record says drinking water but not what kind of fixture.

water-osm-12997991701.summary: Near the east cabins and the Boys Town laundry building. Public access is unconfirmed; ask the Curry Village desk before walking in.

ice-village-store-east.summary: Just outside the Village Store's east entrance, according to a visitor who found the new machine there.
